A horror-comic-style illustration of two anthropomorphic mice standing together in silhouette, watching a massive mushroom cloud rise on a distant horizon. The taller mouse is sleek and white-furred with elongated ears and a small red nose; the shorter mouse is stocky with an oversized head, a grumpy expression, a too-big hat, a red nose, and a kinked tail. Both figures are small in the foreground, dwarfed by the towering nuclear explosion behind them. The scene is rendered in thick inked linework with heavy cross-hatching, dramatic chiaroscuro shadows, and a muted, desaturated palette of ash grey, charcoal, and faded rust, with a harsh white-orange blast glow illuminating swirling dust and debris.
